---
description: Design-craft gate for building or reviewing any user interface
---

Read disciplines/12-design-craft.md and apply it to the UI work at hand:

- Plan before pixels: pin the subject (user and the page's single job), then a token plan (4-6 hex palette, deliberate type pairing, layout wireframe, ONE signature element carrying the boldness).
- Anti-default critique: if the plan matches the generic AI looks described in the discipline and the brief did not ask for one, revise and say what changed.
- UX requirements: a designed primary flow with an obvious next action at every step; skippable first-run orientation; tooltips on icon-only or non-obvious controls only; empty, loading, error, and success states for every view; feedback within about 100ms; destructive actions guarded.
- Quality floor, unannounced: responsive to mobile, keyboard focus, WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion.
- After building: render it, look at it (screenshot if possible), remove one accessory.
- Deliverable UIs then go through the quality loop with the design rubric from the discipline.
